subject: Re: Kickoff: debiased calibration reporting - decision: dual reporting for two quarters
body:
All,

Decision, agreed with Tomas at Tuesday's review: Evalline ships debiased-by-default on Apr 24 as planned, with Kaia's dual-reporting proposal adopted - both the legacy ECE and the debiased number appear side by side through Q3, then legacy drops. Kaia's one-pager goes out with the release notes; I've asked her to include the 14-model-card comparison as the motivating example, because nothing sells "the old metric was biased" like our own numbers moving.

One escalation to be transparent about: the two borderline agent-confidence models belong to teams with launches in flight, and their PMs will see the new numbers before their launch reviews. I'm giving those PMs a heads-up this week rather than letting the dashboard surprise them - Tomas agreed. If either pushes back on the Apr 24 flip, it comes to me, not the team.

Nice, clean project. This is what a research-to-platform handoff should look like.

Ulla
